records.detail: Proposed: Replace the entire text of this paragraph with the following fallback wording: 'Carrier shall be liable for…
records.old_html: Carrier's liability for cargo loss or damage arising from any shipment shall not exceed $50,000 per shipment or $0.50 per pound of affected goods, whichever is less. Carrier shall not be liable for loss of market, consequential, or special damages of any kind.
records.new_html: Carrier shall be liable for cargo loss or damage in the amount of the full actual invoice value of the affected goods, up to $250,000 per shipment. No released rates or per-pound limitations shall apply unless agreed by Shipper in a signed writing.

All claims for cargo loss…
records.old_html: Claims for loss or damage must be filed with Carrier in writing within thirty (30) days of delivery, and any suit must be instituted within six (6) months of claim denial. Claims not timely filed are waived.
records.new_html: All claims for cargo loss, damage, or delay shall be governed by the Carmack Amendment, 49 U.S.C. § 14706. Nothing in this Agreement waives Shipper's rights thereunder.

records.old_html: Carrier shall maintain cargo insurance with limits of not less than $100,000 per occurrence and shall provide evidence of such coverage upon Shipper's written request.
records.new_html: Carrier shall maintain cargo insurance with limits of not less than $250,000 per occurrence and shall furnish Shipper certificates of insurance, naming Shipper as certificate holder, prior to the first shipment hereunder.

records.new_html: Carrier shall maintain commercial automobile liability insurance with a combined single limit of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence.

records.detail: Proposed: Replace the entire body paragraph text with this fallback wording: 'Shipper allows three (3) hours of free…
records.old_html: Shipper allows one (1) hour of free time for loading or unloading. Detention accrues thereafter at $150 per hour or fraction thereof, with no daily maximum, payable without supporting documentation.
records.new_html: Shipper allows three (3) hours of free time for loading or unloading at each facility. Detention accrues thereafter at $65 per hour or fraction thereof, not to exceed $400 per calendar day, invoiced with supporting arrival and departure records.

records.detail:
Proposed: Replace the entire body paragraph text with: '

The fuel surcharge shall be calculated from the U.S.…
records.old_html: A fuel surcharge of eighteen percent (18%) of linehaul charges applies to all shipments and may be adjusted at Carrier's discretion upon notice on Carrier's website.
records.new_html: The fuel surcharge shall be calculated from the U.S. Department of Energy national average diesel price index, adjusted weekly, in accordance with Shipper's published fuel surcharge matrix.

records.detail: Proposed: Replace the entire text of this body paragraph with the following text: 'Shipper shall pay undisputed…
records.old_html: Shipper shall pay Carrier's invoices within fifteen (15) days of invoice date. Amounts unpaid after such period bear a late fee of two percent (2%) per month. Carrier may offset any amounts owed by Shipper against amounts Carrier owes Shipper.
records.new_html: Shipper shall pay undisputed invoices within forty-five (45) days of receipt of a complete and accurate invoice accompanied by the signed proof of delivery. No late fees, interest, or quick-pay deductions shall apply unless agreed in a signed writing.

records.detail: Proposed: Replace the entire body paragraph text with this fallback wording: 'Each party shall indemnify, defend, and…
records.old_html: Shipper shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Carrier, its officers, employees, and agents from and against any and all claims, losses, and liabilities arising out of or related to this Agreement, including claims arising from Carrier's own negligence, except to the extent caused by Carrier's sole willful misconduct.
records.new_html: Each party shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other from third-party claims to the extent caused by the indemnifying party's negligence or willful misconduct, including that of its employees, agents, and subcontractors.

Claims filing window

Claims for loss or damage shall be filed within nine (9) months of the date of delivery or, in the case of non-delivery, the scheduled delivery date. Suit may be instituted within two (2) years from claim denial.

Either party may terminate this…
records.old_html: This Agreement has an initial term of two (2) years and renews automatically for successive one-year terms. Carrier may terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice; Shipper may terminate only for Carrier's uncured material breach after ninety (90) days' written notice.
records.new_html: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice. Shipper may terminate immediately upon written notice if Carrier's required insurance or operating authority lapses.

records.new_html: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Illinois, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Exclusive venue for disputes shall lie in the state and federal courts sitting in Cook County, Illinois.

Safety and compliance

Carrier represents that it holds valid FMCSA operating authority and a Satisfactory safety rating (or is unrated with no pending downgrade). Carrier shall notify Shipper in writing within forty-eight (48) hours of any change in its safety rating, authority, or insurance, or of any out-of-service order.
